quests.description: Every night more Dream Phantoms come, and every night the town dreams worse. A few won't do it. Beat 30, and maybe Dozywick will have one good night's sleep.

quests.title: Ore of Sneezle Sands
quests.description: Even bigger golems live on Sneezle Sands, south of the Hidden Steppe. Defeat 10 and the mystery of the ore is solved.

quests.title: The Temple Below
quests.description: Temple Jellies drift up from the sunken Tidewater Shrine. Defeat 10 of them and the way down will clear.

quests.title: The Wavecrest Dragon
quests.description: The Wavecrest Dragon sleeps in the deepest hall of the Tidewater Shrine. Wake it, and end it.

quests.title: The Silverfang Warden
quests.description: The Silverfang Warden holds the Whispering Hollow, the only way to this road. Defeat him so travellers can pass.

unlocks.name: At the End of the Road

quests.title: Crystal Widows
quests.description: Crystal Widows spin webs across the cave mouth. Clear 10 of them.

quests.title: At the End of the Road
quests.description: The Emerald Dragon waits at the gate of the Emerald City. Only a hero near level 200 should try.

quests.title: Shadow Apes on the Road
quests.description: The Mint Shadow Apes have taken the last stretch of the Emerald Road, and they throw anyone who comes near into the poppies. Only the strongest get through. Beat 25 of them.

quests.title: Turn That Frown Upside Down
quests.description: The oldest oak in Smiling Forest has stopped smiling and swats anyone who walks by. Cheer it up... the hard way.

quests.title: Follow the Pretty Light
quests.description: Travellers keep wandering off the road in Shiverdell, chasing a giant glowing wisp. Snuff out its tricks.

quests.title: Living Legend
quests.description: Level 200! In all my years I've never seen anyone climb so high. There's no level past this one, but there is gold: Meadowbrook's oldest oak drops a leaf of gold once in a hundred years, and I've kept every one for a hero just like you. Take these first. When you're ready, I have two more tasks worthy of you.

quests.title: The Warden, Once More
quests.description: Gold leaf has to be earned. The Silverfang Warden still holds Whispering Hollow, and he's grown no gentler. Beat him once more at the top of your strength, and the next leaves are yours: gauntlets, boots and a Goldleaf weapon for every guild.

quests.title: The Dragon at the Top
quests.description: One last foe. The Emerald Dragon waits at the end of the road, and only a hero who can beat it at full strength should wear Goldleaf armour. Show it who reached the top, then come home to Meadowbrook.

quests.title: The Missing Moon-Mochi
quests.description: The Moon Rabbit Queen has come down to Moonwhisper, furious that someone stole her moon-mochi. Calm her before she flattens the town... with force.

requires.name: Who's Afraid of the Big Bad Wolf?

quests.title: Models Wanted
quests.description: Monsters leave their cards behind now and then. Find five kinds and show me: I'll copy them into toys, and a couple of my best are yours!

quests.title: A Shelf of Monsters
quests.description: Every one of those toys sold before lunch! Show me fifteen kinds of card and I'll fill a whole shelf. There's a soldier and some blocks in it for you.

quests.title: The Toy Parade
quests.description: Thirty kinds of card, and Prismhaven gets a toy parade! I'll share the music box. And the bubbles. And a bear!

quests.title: Rare and Wonderful
quests.description: The rare ones and the big ones too, if you can: fifty kinds of card. One of each of my finest toys for you.

quests.title: The Hundred-Toy Shelf
quests.description: A hundred kinds of monster card! Nobody has ever done it. If you do, you'll have one of every toy I make.

quests.title: Four Oxen and a Lion
quests.description: My three friends and I stood tail to tail, and no lion could reach us. Then we quarrelled and went our own ways, and the Earth Lions have picked us off ever since. Drive off 8 of them.

quests.title: Thunder on the Steppe
quests.description: Golden Clouds roll over the steppe, and their thunder sends the wild bulls stampeding through the herd. Chase off 5 of them so we can graze in peace.

quests.title: The Waterhole
quests.description: Black Bulls have taken the waterhole and let no one else drink. Drive off 10 of them, and tell my friends we'll stand together again.

quests.title: The Monkey and the Crab
quests.description: A Wood Monkey traded me a seed for my rice ball. I grew it into a persimmon tree, and the monkeys climbed it and pelted me with the hard green fruit! Teach 10 Wood Monkeys some manners.

quests.title: Persimmons for Everyone
quests.description: Now the Mint Shadow Apes come down from the hills for the ripe ones. Drive off 6, and the whole coast can share the harvest.

quests.title: Wool for the Lambs
quests.description: The golden hamsters pulled tufts of wool from my lambs to line their burrows, and now the poor dears shiver at night. Bring me 5 Tufts of Wool from the hamsters and I'll knit them new coats.

quests.title: A Flute for Shelly
quests.description: A mud eagle carried off my driftwood flute, the one that calls my grandchildren home. Carve me a new one! The wood crabs hoard driftwood: win a piece from them, then carve it with 2 White Poplar from your bag.

quests.title: A Spare Sail
quests.description: Captain Brine won't cross open water without a spare sail: the winds past the reef tore the Gull's last one to ribbons. The fire crabs drag washed-up sailcloth into their burrows. Win back 4 Sailcloth Scraps from them.

quests.title: A Figurehead for the Gull
quests.description: No sailor crosses to Starfall Isle without a figurehead to watch the stars. The wood monkeys hoard Starwood in their grove: win a piece, then carve the figurehead yourself with 3 Red Yew from your bag.

quests.title: The Star Chart
quests.description: The chart to Starfall Isle blew apart in the same storm. One piece landed in an old chest on Sneezle Sands, an Earth Lion on the Hidden Steppe carried off another, and a Mint Shadow Ape ran off with the third. Find all three, piece the chart together and bring it to Captain Brine.

quests.title: The Lanterns of Glimmerbough
quests.description: Starmoths drink the light from Glimmerbough's lanterns, and each night the village grows a little darker. Win back 6 pinches of Starlight Dust from their wings, so Pip can light them again.

quests.title: The Sleeping Moonflowers
quests.description: Nebula Puffs drift down from the hills at dusk and settle on our moonflowers until they wilt. Drive off 12 of them, and the flowers can open again.

quests.title: The Crystal Garden
quests.description: Crystal Quills keep digging up the crystals I grow my lantern glass from. Teach 10 of them to dig somewhere else!

quests.title: A Lantern for the Stargazer
quests.description: Stargazer Lune watches the sky all night by the light of a candle stub. Let's make her a Star Lantern! Win a Starfall Shard from a Crystal Quill, then join it to 3 pinches of Starlight Dust from your bag.

quests.title: The Fallen Star
quests.description: Long ago a star fell on this island, and Glimmerbough grew up round the crystals it left. Now it has woken on the hill, lonely and far from home, and its light burns anyone who comes near. Calm it, and help it find its way back to the sky.

quests.title: Into the Glimmerdeep
quests.description: Since the star went home, the crystals it left are all the light we have, and Prism Crabs keep crawling up from the caves to snip them off for their shells! The way down to the Glimmerdeep is north of the village. Beat 10 of them for me.

quests.title: Lanterns That Never Go Out
quests.description: Floating Geodes drift through the Glimmerdeep with glimmerstone in their hearts, and a lantern could burn on one for a hundred years. Win 5 pieces of Glimmerstone from them, and Glimmerbough need never go dark again.

quests.title: The Prism Drake
quests.description: At the bottom of the Glimmerdeep sleeps a drake with scales of living crystal, curled round the brightest shard of all. It has been drinking the light the star left behind, and the island's crystals grow dimmer each night. Wake it, calm it, and let the light go free.

quests.title: Hamsters in the Granary
quests.description: Golden Hamsters have found my granary, and they've been stuffing their cheeks all week. Shoo four of them off before there's no flour left for Cloverdale's bread!

quests.title: The Clover Thieves
quests.description: My bees won't leave the hive! The Yellow Butterflies have taken over the clover and won't share a single flower. Chase five of them off, and my bees will thank you. Quietly. They're shy.

quests.title: Honey for Tilly
quests.description: Tilly the Toymaker in Prismhaven glues her toys together with honey, if you can believe it. She's run out. Take her this jar, slowly, and come and tell me she got it.

objective.text: Honey! Barnaby's honey! Now my wooden bees will stick to their flowers again. Tell him thank you, with a hug from me.

quests.title: Seeds for Spring
quests.description: Those hamsters didn't only eat the grain. They ran off with my seed pouches, every one, and spring planting is next week! Bring back four, and Barnaby and I will have something for you.

quests.title: A Letter for the Mayor
quests.description: Could you take this letter to Mayor Poppy in Prismhaven? Don't peek! It's about the flour for the city's festival cakes. She'll want to write back, so bring me her answer.

objective.text: A letter from Rosie! Oh, the festival cakes. Of course, as much flour as she can spare. Here, take her my reply, and mind the ribbon.

quests.title: Socks on the Hedgehogs
quests.description: A gust took my whole washing line last night! Now the Hedgehogs are trundling round the Downs with my socks stuck on their spines. Bring back five socks. Odd ones are fine.

quests.title: A Hamster for Kite Day
quests.description: Every Kite Day, a brave little friend rides in the basket of the lead kite. Seal a Golden Hamster with these Seal Stones and bring it along. It stays your friend after, of course.

quests.title: Kite Day
quests.description: Kite Day is here, and the Fluffy Bunnies keep nibbling through the kite strings! Chase eight of them off so every kite in Thistledown can fly.

quests.title: Crabs in the Nets
quests.description: The Wood Crabs have found my nets, and they snip through the knots faster than I can tie them. Send six of them scuttling, and I'll have these nets mended before the tide.

quests.title: The Stolen Catch
quests.description: Every time the boats come in, the Mud Eagles swoop down and fly off with the best of the catch. Win five Silver Fish back from them, and the whole cove eats tonight.

quests.title: A Light on the Point
quests.description: The lamp on the point went out in last week's storm, and the boats can't find the cove at night. Gather three Glow Shells from the Wood Crabs, piece them together on a frame of White Poplar, and bring me the lantern.

quests.title: Gold in the Goo
quests.description: The Golden Slimes swallow every nugget we dig up, then wobble off with them! Pop five of them and bring the gold back. Goldie will want to weigh it, of course.

quests.title: Lights Out
quests.description: The Mud Slimes keep oozing over our lanterns and putting them out, and nobody can dig in the dark. Clear eight of them out of the tunnels, and the camp's lamps stay lit.

quests.title: Shells for the Lanterns
quests.description: My lantern glass has run out, so I make do with Dark Beetle shells. Polished up, they glow a lovely violet. Bring me six, and Duskhollow stays lit.

quests.title: Werewolves at the Woodpile
quests.description: Something knocks over my woodpile every night and howls about it. Werewolves, five of them at least. Teach them some manners, and my kilns can burn again.

quests.title: The Werewolf Pack
quests.description: A whole pack of Werewolves has moved into the woods, and they howl at my kiln all night. This is no job for a beginner. Beat 20 of them, and the woods might sleep again.

quests.title: The Night Market
quests.description: Once a month Duskhollow holds a market by lantern light, and this time the Night Monkeys are raiding the stalls before we've even opened! Chase eight of them off, and the market's yours.

quests.title: Wake the Dusk Waystone
quests.description: There's an old waystone past my workshop. Awake, it'll carry you to any town you've been to, and to any other waystone that's awake. But the Dark Beetles have crawled all over it and smothered its glow. Clear away 8 of them and it'll wake.

quests.title: Oil for the Candles
quests.description: Chandler Mabbott in Shiverdell makes a candle that never burns down, and I make the oil that glows. We trade. Take him this flask, through the woods and the valley, and bring back what he gives you.

objective.text: Fenwick's glowing oil! Here, an Everlasting Wick for him in return. The Wisps can huff and puff all they like at this one.

quests.title: Monkeys in the Orchard
quests.description: The Wood Monkeys raid my trees every morning and run off with the best apples. Win six back from them. I'd like to save a few for the fair.

quests.title: Hog Wild
quests.description: The Wood Hogs dig up truffles all over the forest and gobble them before anyone else gets a sniff. Bring me five, and I'll brew Hollyhock's famous Truffle Cider. It's an acquired taste.

quests.title: The Apple Fair
quests.description: The Flame Sheep keep wandering into the orchard and toasting the apples on the branch. Toasted apples are lovely, but not before the fair! Herd six of them away.

quests.title: Sticky Fingers
quests.description: The Candy Puffs have been licking my sugar crystals clean off the rocks! Pop five of them and bring the crystals back. I need them for Peppermint Row's rock candy.

quests.title: Toffee Too Hot
quests.description: Toffee's all about the heat, and the Flame Sheep keep wandering through my kitchen and burning every batch! Herd six of them away from Peppermint Row.

quests.title: The Gingerbread Gala
quests.description: Every year Peppermint Row crowns a Gala Queen, and every year the crown gets eaten. This year it's rock candy: piece four Sugar Crystals together round a piece of Amber, and bring me the crown.

quests.title: Croaking Under the Boardwalk
quests.description: The Blue Treefrogs croak under the boardwalks all night, and nobody in Bogbottom has slept in a week. Quiet six of them down, and we'll all thank you. In the morning. After a nap.

quests.title: Mud for the Poultice
quests.description: Mud Slimes are made of the best mud in the swamp, the warm, healing kind. Bring me five dollops for my poultices. Don't ask how I found out.

quests.title: Slime on the Stilts
quests.description: The Water Slugs climb our stilts at night and leave everything as slippery as soap. Old Bess fell in twice yesterday! Clear ten of them out, and Bogbottom can stand up straight again.

quests.title: Little Red's Basket
quests.description: I was taking a basket of honey muffins to Grandmother when the Earth Wolves knocked me over and ran off with them! Get five muffins back. Grandmother can tell if one's missing. She counts.

quests.title: Wolves at the Window
quests.description: The Flame Wolves prowl round my cottage every night and breathe on the windows till the glass steams up. Chase eight of them off and let an old woman get some sleep.

quests.title: The Long Howl
quests.description: The Werewolves howl at Grandmother's cottage all night long. Huntsman Corwin says they only want the muffins, but I'm not taking chances. Make four of them think twice.

quests.title: Frogs in the Ferry
quests.description: The Treefrogs have taken to jumping into my ferry halfway across, and one of them steered us into the reeds yesterday! Clear eight of them off the lake so Reedwater can cross in peace.

quests.title: Wisp-Light Thread
quests.description: My finest lace is stitched with thread spun from wisp-light. The Wisps drift over the lake at dusk, trailing it behind them. Bring me five skeins of their glow.

quests.title: A Veil for Odette
quests.description: The swan girl on the island has watched over Reedwater for years, and nobody has ever given her anything. Piece three skeins of Wisp Silk together with an Emerald clasp, and we'll send her the finest veil the lake has seen.

quests.title: Lions at the Lantern Fence
quests.description: The Earth Lions prowl round our lantern fence every night, roaring at the candles. Send six of them back to the hills, and Candlewick's children can sleep again.

quests.title: Horn Lanterns
quests.description: In Shiverdell a candle needs a horn lantern round it, or the first gust and the first Wisp put it out. Bring me five horns from the Bulls. They grow new ones, don't worry.

quests.title: The Amber Werewolf
quests.description: There's a rare Werewolf in Shiverdell with fur like amber, and it eats my candles, wax and all. You'll be lucky to see one. Beat 6 of them and I'll believe in luck.

quests.title: The Silent Bell
quests.description: A Night Monkey climbed the belfry and ran off with the bell's clapper, and now the valley's gone quiet. Without the bell, everyone feels alone in the dark. Get it back!

quests.title: The Waystone in the Mist
quests.description: The waystone by my bell went dark the night the Wisps came. They drink its light, the greedy things. Chase off 8 Wisps and I'll ring it awake. Then it'll take you anywhere you've been, and back here again.

quests.title: Too Many Rats
quests.description: The Fire Rats breed faster than I can count, and I count fast. Thin them out, ten of them, and the camp might last the week.

quests.title: Rat-Proof Boots
quests.description: Earth Snakes shed scales as hard as iron, and nothing makes a better boot. Not even a Fire Rat can bite through it. Bring me five, and I'll make you a pair too.

quests.title: Sprites in the Dew
quests.description: The Lotus Sprites drink the morning dew before I can gather it, and dew is all we tiny folk drink! Win back six Dew Pearls from them. They're round, and very, very clean.

quests.title: Slugs on the Lily Pads
quests.description: The Water Slugs are eating the lily pads, and half of Lilypad Landing lives on lily pads! Send eight of the gluttons packing before we're all swimming.

quests.title: The Lantern Float
quests.description: Every summer we float a lantern down the stream for luck, and this year it's your turn to make it! Piece three Dew Pearls together on a stick of Bamboo, and bring the lantern to me.

quests.title: Beetles in the Workshop
quests.description: Dark Beetles bore into my wood and turn good puppets into sieves. Squash eight of them before they reach the workshop, and Stringwood's toys are safe.

quests.title: Cut Strings
quests.description: The runaway puppets still trail their golden strings, and every string is a little bit of magic. Snip six of them free and bring them back to me.

quests.title: The Midsummer Show
quests.description: The Midsummer Show starts at dusk, and the wild puppets want to take over the stage again! Round up twelve of them, so for once the show goes the way I wrote it.

quests.title: Lizards in the Well
quests.description: The Black Lizards climb down into the well to cool off, and then they won't climb out! Chase eight of them away before the caravans arrive thirsty.

quests.title: Sand in the Waystone
quests.description: The waystone near my well used to hum. Now it's quiet: the Light Snakes coil round it to soak up its warmth. Drive away 8 of them and it'll sing again, and carry travellers across the sand in a single step.

quests.title: A Cure for the Camels
quests.description: My camels won't drink, and they're always thirsty. Herbalist Mungo in the Frog Swamp knows every cure there is. Take him a flask of my well water to look at, and bring back whatever he says will help.

objective.text: Hmm. Sniff. Sand, and a little too much salt. Easy! Here's a tonic: one drop in the trough, and her camels will drink like ducks.

quests.title: Wicks of Light
quests.description: A lamp burns brightest with a Light Hedgehog's quill for a wick. They shed them all over the dunes, but only when you've given them a good reason. Bring me five.

quests.title: The Genie's Lamp
quests.description: Storyteller Hakim swears a genie lived in the oasis long ago, and left when its lamp went dark. Piece three Sun Quills together round a Gold Ingot, and let's make a lamp worth coming home to.

quests.title: Violet in the Dunes
quests.description: The Violet Black Lizards are the rarest thing in the desert, rarer than a genie with manners. Their scales make the finest lamp-glass. Beat 8 of them, if you can find that many.

quests.title: Hot Crabs
quests.description: Fire Crabs climb aboard every raft that comes in and set the ropes smouldering. Clear eight of them off the wharf before something important catches.

quests.title: Lizard-Licked Ore
quests.description: The Mining Lizards lick the ore off the rafts like it's candy, then wander off with a mouthful. Bring me back six lumps of Raw Ore, and my forge can roar again.

quests.title: Golems on the Rafts
quests.description: Dreamstone Golems have started riding the ore rafts down the lake, and they sink every one they sit on. Teach eight of them to walk, and Emberwharf's rafts can float again.

quests.title: Stones That Float
quests.description: The Floating Stones drift over our diggings and drop on whoever's below. Bring ten of them down for good, and Geode Hollow can dig without hard hats. Well, with fewer.

quests.title: Crawler Gems
quests.description: The Gem Crawlers swallow the rough gems we dig up and wear them on their backs. Win six of them back for my wheel.

quests.title: The Prism Lamp
quests.description: Geode Hollow has always wanted a lamp that throws rainbows on the mountain at night. Piece three Rough Gems together round a Diamond, and we'll light it on the highest roof.

quests.title: Bad Bedtime Stories
quests.description: The Phantoms drift through our walls every night and whisper bedtime stories, and they're terrible stories! Send eight of them off, so Wakewell can stay awake in peace.

quests.title: Beans for the Roaster
quests.description: The Poison Skeletons raided my bean sacks! Skeletons don't sleep either, so they drink a lot of coffee. Rattle them till they drop my beans, and bring me six handfuls.

quests.title: Coffee for the Dwarfs
quests.description: The dwarfs in the Snow White Forest work through the winter nights and they've run out of coffee. Foreman Barrowby ordered my darkest roast. Take him this sack. He said he'd send something back for my trouble.

objective.text: Coffee! Seven dwarfs thank you, and so do I. Here, a kettle we hammered out for Bastian. Tell him it boils in a blink.

quests.title: A Lullaby for Wakewell
quests.description: The Dream Phantoms have hoarded every good dream in the valley, and that's why nobody here can sleep. Win five Sweet Dreams back from them. Tonight, Wakewell sleeps!

quests.title: A Waystone That Won't Wake
quests.description: Even our waystone has nodded off! The Poison Skeletons rattle round it all night and nobody gets a wink. Rattle 8 of them to pieces and it might open an eye. Awake, it'll take you anywhere you've been.

quests.title: Bears at the Woodpile
quests.description: The Frost Bears come down to our woodpile and breathe frost all over it, and not one log will catch. Send eight of them back up the mountain, and the seven hearths can burn on dry wood.

quests.title: Frost Apples
quests.description: The Snowmen roll through the orchard and the apples freeze right into them. Frost Apples are the sweetest thing in the forest! Bring me five for the dwarfs' pie. Don't worry, they're not poisoned.

quests.title: The Seven Hearths Feast
quests.description: Once a winter the seven dwarfs hold a feast by all seven hearths, and the Frost Bears always sniff it out. Keep eight of them away tonight, and you're our guest of honour.

quests.title: Apes in the Rice
quests.description: The Shadow Apes raided the store of Moon Rice we keep for the festival mochi! Win six sacks back from them, or the Moon-Viewing Night will have nothing to eat.

quests.title: Rattling on the Steps
quests.description: Every night the Poison Skeletons climb our steps, rattling so loudly I can't hear myself think, let alone the stars. Send ten of them clattering back down the hill.

quests.title: The Moon-Viewing Night
quests.description: Tonight the moon is full, and the first tray of mochi is always left out for the Moon Rabbit Queen. Piece three sacks of Moon Rice together on a Bamboo tray, and bring it to me.

quests.title: Fire in the Grass
quests.description: When the Blaze Bulls stampede, the tall grass catches light behind them, and Tallgrass is made of grass. Turn ten of them before the whole steppe goes up.

quests.title: The Waystone in the Tall Grass
quests.description: My grandmother's grandmother crossed the whole world in one step, through the waystone in the tall grass. The Mint Black Widows have spun it shut. Cut through 10 of them and it'll open for you too.

quests.title: Manes for the Drums
quests.description: A Tallgrass drum is trimmed with an Earth Lion's mane, so it roars when you beat it. Bring me five tufts. The lions grow it back, and they're vain about it.

quests.title: The Great Drum
quests.description: The Great Drum calls every herd on the steppe home, and its skin split in the last storm. Piece three Lion's Manes together with a Crocodile Hide, and bring me a drum worth beating.

quests.title: Crabs in the Salt Pans
quests.description: The Fire Crabs scuttle through my salt pans and boil the water dry before the salt can set. Chase ten of them back to the rocks.

quests.title: Peppers Gone Missing
quests.description: The Wood Monkeys stripped my whole pepper patch, and now they sit in the trees sneezing at me. Win six Fire Peppers back. Don't rub your eyes after.

quests.title: The Great Sneeze
quests.description: Every year the whole bay sneezes at once for luck, and somebody has to make the powder. This year it's you! Grind three Fire Peppers in a Bamboo mortar and bring it here. Stand back.

quests.title: Bears on the Ice
quests.description: The Frost Bears wander out onto the ice and sit on our fishing holes till they freeze over. Shoo ten of them back to the shore, and Icemoor can fish again.

quests.title: Something Wobbly for the Soup
quests.description: My secret? A spoonful of Temple Jelly thickens a soup like nothing else, and it keeps you warm all night. Bring me six frozen chunks. Don't tell anyone what's in it.

quests.title: The Lion in the Frost
quests.description: A lion with frost in its mane prowls round Briarmere, and it's knocked my soup pot over three times. They're rare, and they're fierce. Beat 8 of them and you'll eat for free here forever.

quests.title: Ice Lantern Night
quests.description: On Ice Lantern Night the whole of Icemoor lights the lake, and every year someone carves the Ice Swan at its heart. This year, you! Win three blocks of Clear Ice from the Snowmen and carve the swan in your bag.

quests.title: The Frozen Waystone
quests.description: There's a waystone under all this ice, and the Frosted Phantoms keep it frozen. Send 10 of them packing and I'll chip it free. A waystone that's awake will take you to any town or waystone you've been to.

quests.title: An Ice Rose for Blanche
quests.description: Housekeeper Blanche in the Snow White Forest once fed me soup when I was lost in the snow. I carved her a rose out of ice that will never melt. Will you take it to her, and come back to tell me what she said?

objective.text: An ice rose? For me? From Sigrun! Oh, tell her it's going on the mantelpiece, between the seven hearths, where everyone can see it.

quests.title: Thieves on the Steps
quests.description: The Gem Crawlers climb the shrine steps at low tide and pry the pearls out of the walls. Send ten of them scuttling back into the deep.

quests.title: Pearls for the Pilgrims' Stew
quests.description: Every Temple Jelly carries a little pearl in its middle, and my stew isn't the same without one. Bring me six. The pilgrims say it's the pearls that give them their second wind.

quests.title: An Offering for the Tide
quests.description: Once a year the pilgrims set an offering on the shrine's last dry step, so the tide stays kind. Piece three Jelly Pearls together round a Dragon Pearl, and bring it here.

quests.title: Crystal Silk
quests.description: The Crystal Widows spin the finest thread in all the land, and they guard it jealously. Win six skeins from them, and I'll weave something the whole hollow will whisper about.

quests.title: Tangles in the Dark
quests.description: The Black Widows keep tangling my looms with their sticky webs, and their silk is no good to anyone. Clear ten of them away, and my gloves are yours.

quests.title: Pegasi in the Poppies
quests.description: The Emerald Pegasi land in my poppy field to graze, then fall asleep in it and squash every flower. Wake ten of them up and send them flying.

quests.title: The Waystone Among the Poppies
quests.description: There's a waystone in my poppy field, nodding off like everyone else round here. The Starry Fire Bears trample about it and scorch the poppies. Beat 10 of them and it'll wake right up, ready to take you anywhere you've been.

quests.title: Cloud Glass
quests.description: The finest lenses are ground from Cloud Glass, the little golden drops a Golden Cloud rains when it's beaten. Bring me six, and I can finally fill my orders.

quests.title: Spectacles for the Gate
quests.description: Nobody may walk through the Emerald Gates without green spectacles, and the gatekeeper's own pair cracked when the dragon came. Piece two Cloud Glass lenses together with an Emerald, and we'll make new ones.

quests.title: A Map of the Deep
quests.description: Pip wants to draw a map of the Glimmerdeep, every level of it, so nobody gets lost in the dark again. The ink is light, and the brightest light down there is inside the Floating Geodes. Bring Pip theirs, and the map is yours.

quests.title: The Waystone Under the Stars
quests.description: There's a waystone up here in the meadow, and the Lantern Sprites keep stealing its glow for their lanterns. It's gone all dim and sleepy. Catch 10 of them and give the light back, and it'll wake up and take you anywhere you've been, no boat needed.

items.name: Potion
items.description: Restores 40 HP.

items.name: Ether
items.description: Restores 20 MP.

items.name: Seal Stone

items.name: Starlight Dust
items.description: Glittering dust from a Starmoth's wings. It glows a little brighter in the dark.

items.name: Starfall Shard
items.description: A shard of star-glass a Crystal Quill dug up. It hums, very softly.

items.name: Star Lantern
items.description: A lantern of star-glass with Starlight Dust glowing inside. It never needs lighting.

items.name: Glimmerwing Boots
items.description: Stitched from wings the Starmoths shed. You land more softly than you jumped.

items.name: Starweave Robe
items.description: Woven in Glimmerbough from moonflower silk. At night, tiny stars drift across it.

items.name: Starweave Hat
items.description: A wizard's hat, to wear with the robe of the same name.

items.name: Starpetal Gauntlets
items.description: Silver gauntlets set with crystal petals from Pip's garden. They chime when you make a fist.

items.name: Stargazer's Band
items.description: Stargazer Lune's thank-you: a band of night-blue silver. Look through it, and the stars come closer.

items.name: Fallen Star Pendant
items.description: A sliver of the Fallen Star, given gladly. It's warm, and it hums when you're far from home.

items.name: Starfall Staff
items.description: Its tip holds a spark the Fallen Star left behind.

items.name: Starfall Blade
items.description: Forged in starlight. It leaves a trail of sparks.

items.name: Starfall Axe
items.description: Its edge glitters like a falling star.

items.name: Starfall Whip
items.description: It cracks like a shooting star, and beasts follow its light.

items.name: Seed Pouch
items.description: A little sack of seeds, slightly chewed. A hamster's idea of a packed lunch.

items.name: Honeybee Charm
items.description: Barnaby carved it from honeycomb wax, and Rosie dusted it with flour for luck. It smells of clover.

items.name: Stray Sock
items.description: A striped woollen sock with a few spiny holes in it. Its partner is still out there somewhere.

items.name: Windstep Sandals
items.description: Bryn laced them with kite string. On a windy day you hardly touch the ground.

items.name: Silver Fish
items.description: A fat silver herring with eagle talon marks. Still fresh, more or less.

items.name: Glow Shell
items.description: A Wood Crab's spare shell. It glows a soft sea-green when the sun goes down.

items.name: Shell Lantern
items.description: Three Glow Shells on a little frame of White Poplar. Bright enough to guide a boat home.

items.name: Tidecaller Pendant
items.description: Marla's mother wore it on the boats. Hold it to your ear and the sea talks back.

items.name: Gold Nugget
items.description: A lump of real gold, still a little sticky. Goldie will want it washed first.

items.name: Prospector's Gloves
items.description: Thick leather gloves with brass knuckles, slime-proof and goo-proof. Mostly.

items.name: Beetle Shell
items.description: A Dark Beetle's wing case. Polish it and it glows a deep violet.

items.name: Owl-Eye Amulet
items.description: A round amber stone that sees in the dark. Fenwick swears it blinks.

items.name: Crisp Apple
items.description: A shiny red apple with one small monkey bite. Monkeys have good taste.

items.name: Forest Truffle
items.description: A knobbly brown truffle that smells of earth, rain and hog.

items.name: Orchard Gloves
items.description: Moss's picking gloves, soft as moss and green as leaves. Apples just drop into them.

items.name: Sugar Crystal
items.description: A pink crystal of pure sugar, only a little licked.

items.name: Rock Candy Crown
items.description: A crown of pink rock candy with an Amber jewel. Please don't eat it before the Gala.

items.name: Peppermint Boots
items.description: Red and white like a peppermint stick, and they leave a minty smell wherever you walk.

items.name: Healing Mud
items.description: A warm dollop of swamp mud. It smells awful and works wonders.

items.name: Bogwalker Boots
items.description: Tall waders that never leak. Ida swears by them, and at them, now and then.

items.name: Honey Muffin
items.description: A golden honey muffin, a bit squashed. Grandmother will still eat it.

items.name: Red Hood Ribbon
items.description: A ribbon from Little Red's cape. Wolves think twice when they see it.

items.name: Wisp Silk
items.description: A skein of thread spun from a Wisp's glow. It's warm, and it hums very softly.

items.name: Swan Lace Veil
items.description: A veil of glowing lace with an Emerald clasp, light as a swan's feather.

items.name: Swan Feather Brooch
items.description: A white swan's feather pinned with silver. Odette sent it over with the ferry, without a word.

items.name: Bull Horn
items.description: A curved horn, polished smooth. Shaved thin, it lets candlelight through like amber.

items.name: Bell Clapper
items.description: The iron tongue of Candlewick's bell. A monkey has been chewing it.

items.name: Bell-Ringer's Gloves
items.description: Rope-worn gloves with brass bells on the cuffs. They ring when you fight.

items.name: Snake Scale
items.description: A brown scale as hard as iron and as smooth as a pebble.

items.name: Ratcatcher's Boots
items.description: Scaled boots that no rat can bite through. Bodkin made a pair for you, and three for himself.

items.name: Dew Pearl
items.description: A dewdrop as round as a pearl. It never dries up, and it tastes of morning.

items.name: Lotus Lantern
items.description: A tiny lantern of dew pearls on a bamboo stick. It floats.

items.name: Lotus Dew Charm
items.description: A pink lotus bud with a dew pearl at its heart. The tiny folk say it brings gentle luck.

items.name: Golden String
items.description: A puppet's golden string. It still twitches now and then, out of habit.

items.name: Heartwood Locket
items.description: A locket carved from the heart of the puppet tree, with a tiny puppet inside. It waves.

items.name: Sun Quill
items.description: A Light Hedgehog's quill, still glowing like a sunbeam.

items.name: Genie's Lamp
items.description: A gold oil lamp with three Sun Quills for a wick. Rub it, if you dare.

items.name: Genie's Ring
items.description: When the lamp lit, a puff of blue smoke left this ring on Kasim's counter. No wishes, sadly.

items.name: Raw Ore
items.description: A lump of ore, still sticky with lizard. Bruna doesn't mind.

items.name: Forgehand Gauntlets
items.description: Bruna forged them in her own fire. They stay warm on the coldest morning.

items.name: Rough Gem
items.description: An uncut gem, cloudy and lumpy. Iolanthe can see a shape in it already.

items.name: Prism Lamp
items.description: A lamp of cut gems round a Diamond heart. Light it, and rainbows spill everywhere.

items.name: Prism Pendant
items.description: A prism Iolanthe cut from the lamp's last gem. It throws tiny rainbows wherever you go.

items.name: Coffee Beans
items.description: A handful of dark roasted beans. One sniff and you'll be up till Tuesday.

items.name: Sweet Dream
items.description: A good dream in a little glass jar, glowing like a night light. Shh.

items.name: Dozy Slippers
items.description: Fluffy slippers so soft you could fall asleep standing. You won't, though. You'll just walk very quietly.

items.name: Frost Apple
items.description: A rosy apple with a crust of frost. Perfectly safe. Perfectly delicious.

items.name: Seven Hearths Ring
items.description: Seven tiny gems, one from each dwarf. Warm as a fireside, even in the snow.

items.name: Moon Rice
items.description: A little sack of rice so white it glows by moonlight. Perfect for mochi.

items.name: Mochi Tray
items.description: Round white mochi stacked on a bamboo tray, the first for the Moon Rabbit Queen.

items.name: Moon Rabbit Charm
items.description: A silver rabbit sitting in a crescent moon. Selene says the Queen herself sent it down.

items.name: Lion's Mane
items.description: A tawny tuft of an Earth Lion's mane, thick and a little dusty.

items.name: Great Drum
items.description: A big drum trimmed with lion's mane. Beat it once and the steppe answers.

items.name: Steppe-Runner Boots
items.description: Soft hide boots for running through grass taller than you. They never stumble.

items.name: Fire Pepper
items.description: A shiny red pepper so hot it's warm to hold. Achoo.

items.name: Sneezing Powder
items.description: A bamboo pot of red powder. Don't open it indoors. Don't open it at all, really.

items.name: Pepperfire Gauntlets
items.description: Red gauntlets with pepper-shaped studs. Your punches come with a little heat.

items.name: Frozen Jelly
items.description: A frozen chunk of Temple Jelly. It still wobbles a little, somehow.

items.name: Clear Ice
items.description: A block of ice so clear you can read through it. A Snowman was keeping it.

items.name: Ice Swan
items.description: A swan carved out of clear ice, wings half open. It might fly off if you look away.

items.name: Frostlight Pendant
items.description: A drop of lake ice that never melts, with a lantern's light caught inside.

items.name: Jelly Pearl
items.description: A soft-glowing pearl from a Temple Jelly's middle. It smells faintly of the sea.

items.name: Offering Shell
items.description: A white shell holding four pearls, one of them a dragon's. The tide will like it.

items.name: Tidesong Ring
items.description: A ring of sea-green silver. Hold it to your ear, and the tide sings.

items.name: Crystal Silk
items.description: A skein of silk as clear as glass and stronger than steel. It whispers when it moves.

items.name: Crystal-Silk Gloves
items.description: Woven from Crystal Widow silk by Arachne herself. Light as air, tough as steel.

items.name: Cloud Glass
items.description: A drop of golden glass rained by a Golden Cloud. Perfectly round, perfectly clear.

items.name: Emerald Spectacles
items.description: Round spectacles with green glass. Through them, the whole world is emerald.

items.name: Emerald Glass Amulet
items.description: Fennimore's best lens, set in gold. Look through it and you'll see the city past the gate.

items.name: Glimmerstone
items.description: A lump of geode from the Glimmerdeep, glowing softly from the inside. A lantern could burn on it for a hundred years.

items.name: Sealed Letter
items.description: A letter sealed with green wax. Rosie says it's private, which means it's about cake.

items.name: Mayor's Reply
items.description: A rolled letter tied with a red ribbon, the city's gold seal on it.

items.name: Jar of Honey
items.description: Barnaby's best clover honey, the lid tied down tight. The bees counted every drop.

items.name: Flask of Lantern Oil
items.description: Fenwick's own lantern oil. It glows a little in the dark, all by itself.

items.name: Everlasting Wick
items.description: A candle with a blue flame that never burns it down. Mabbott's finest.

items.name: Flask of Well Water
items.description: Clear, cold water from Samira's well, for Mungo to have a look at.

items.name: Herbal Tonic

items.name: Sack of Coffee

items.name: Dwarf-Forged Kettle
items.description: A round copper kettle the dwarfs hammered out for Bastian. It boils in a blink.

items.name: Ice Rose

changelog.title: Tall grass
notes: Tall grass grows in the green lands, bending, rustling and flattening as you wade through it.
Flowers grow knee-high, no longer as tall as the trees.
Text all through the game is in a rounder, easier-to-read font; titles keep their bold look.
Every town's houses and shops, and the great landmarks, are redrawn with more charm and detail.

changelog.title: Clearer screens
notes: Battles show your party's HP and MP, and the victory card fills your EXP bar.
Track a quest under the minimap, see each quest's progress, and find it on the map.
The Bag shows its empty slots; hold an item to equip or use it.
Shops have Buy and Sell tabs, and the smith says what you still need and where it comes from.
The daily gift shows the whole week's presents.

changelog.title: Emotes
notes: Every kind of weapon sounds its own in battle, and nights fall moonlit and soft.
Towns have sandstone terraces with balustrades, and cobbled streets with grass along their edges.
Pick an emote by the chat's box: a heart, a wave, a laugh and more pop up over your head, and adventurers nearby answer.
Speech bubbles have curved tails, and reflections in the water take on its colour.
Hills in every wild land rise in terraces with rock cliffs and waterfalls.

changelog.title: Beyond level 200
notes: At level 200, EXP fills a mastery bar: every full bar is another skill point.
Reach level 200 for the Legend's Cape at the weaver.
Your bag grows as you level, from 50 slots to 100 at level 200.
Cave floors no longer glitch, and the cave map matches the world map.
Lakes and rivers have grassy edges, rocks in the shallows, water that deepens and mirrors the sky, and waterfalls where the rivers spring.

changelog.title: A living world
notes: Trees rustle in the wind and cast deep shade that stretches as the sun sinks; days last longer, and travel skips the clock ahead.
Waves roll in to the shore over shallows that follow every bay, and open fields no longer show a grid.
At night the street lamps light up the houses round them, and in caves your light stops at the rock.
Items have a rarity, from Uncommon to Legendary, on their slot; a rare find sparkles as it turns up.
Hold the joystick for a couple of seconds and you break into a run, which uses MP; in battle every blow lands with a jolt.

changelog.title: A fresh look
notes: A new welcome: the story and How to play in slides, each step played out in a little scene.
Dye your gear: mix a dye from a gem and a sheepskin, then ask the weaver or a barber to colour your armour or a weapon, and its trim in a second colour.
Battle buttons sit in one row along the bottom, your skills line up side by side, and chat waits until the fight is over.
Windows open bigger with a title bar and folder tabs, their lists in tidy groups; the world map shows the time and where you are.
Everyone blinks and breathes as they stand, gloves and boots show on every hero, dyes keep a piece's shading, and Other is back as a gender.

changelog.title: A new name: Tales of Dorlune
notes: The game has a new name: Tales of Dorlune. The land Liora bound from the world's fairy tales is called Dorlune.
Your hero, saves and progress are just as you left them.
A new logo and app icon to go with the name: Tales of Dorlune in gold, and your hero on the Home Screen.
At Halloween, Christmas and Easter the app icon dresses up for the season.
Every item in your bag is redrawn: bigger, smoother pictures with clean edges.

changelog.title: Bigger battles
notes: Bosses tower over their waves and step forward with their name across the field, their health along the top as you fight.
Your skills are tiles in battle, greyed out when you're short of MP.
Your strongest skills sweep a crescent of light through your foes or bring a pillar of light down from the sky, and a skill that reaches a whole side marks everyone with a rune circle first.
Names stay out of the way: hold a fighter to read theirs, and let go over a monster to pick it.
With friends at your side, their faces tick off as each one chooses, and your side stands on blue.

changelog.title: The bank
notes: A bank in every town and in Glimmerbough: leave your gold and things with the banker, and they're safe whatever happens.
Your bag holds 50 kinds of thing, your coins one of them, in a pile that grows. What doesn't fit is left behind.
Lose a fight and what you carry, coins and all, is left where you fell (in a duel, what you wear too): get back to it before someone else picks it up.
Smiths forge armor now too. Put anything up for trade and adventurers walk over with offers to accept or decline.
Already playing? Everything you carried is waiting for you in the bank.

changelog.title: A cleaner screen
notes: One menu button opens into Hero, Companion, Friends, Inventory, Quests and Settings, each a window that grows out of it, with Chat right beside it.
Your EXP bar sits under your health and magic, and what you win and find pops up for a moment, then waits in the chat.
Every boss waits in a lair worth finding: at its land's edge, on a hilltop or in a cave, ringed by dead trees, standing stones or broken pillars, with a warning where its trail begins.
Skill icons glow like the spells they cast, and now so do the icons on every button. Your skills are tiles: tap one to see it and raise it a level.
How to play shows the world as it really lies. Cities have new stone walls, and every town a gate of its own.

changelog.title: Skills that keep growing
notes: Your hero's skills keep growing past Mastered, up to level 50: a little stronger every level, with new milestones at 20, 30, 40 and 50 (Heroic, Epic, Mythic and Legendary).
Each milestone makes the skill grander in battle: wider magic circles and more light, the ground shaking from Epic, a second strike from Mythic, and every colour at Legendary.
Skill icons glow like the spells they cast, houses catch the light and shade like the rest of the town, and waystones have a cyan badge of their own on the map.
Raise a companion to level 200 and the weaver makes you the Beastfriend Cape. The critters about the lands are redrawn too.
Every boss now waits in a lair of its own: a ring of standing stones, a dragon's hoard, a throne of junk, with lit braziers at the way in.

changelog.title: Night skies and new item art
notes: Dark Mode: the game follows your phone's look, or pick Light or Dark in Settings. The app icon has a night version too.
Over three hundred items are repainted to match the rest of the game's art: lit and shaded, with rounder helmets, hoods, boots and gloves.

Every land grows trees and bushes of its own: cherries, willows, birches, maples, frosted bare trees, firs and brambles, no longer one tree in different colours. Whips hang from the hand in their icons.
The towns have new houses and shops: thatched and timber-framed cottages, a stone townhouse, a round cottage, a teapot house, and shops for weapons, armour, clothes, flowers, tea and books.
Lakes and rivers have shallows, deep water and banks; the deserts build tents and domed houses, the steppe yurts and Starfall Isle tree houses; and the skill and button icons are repainted too.

changelog.title: Waystones and favours
notes: Seven waystones out in the wild wake when you finish their quests: touch one to travel free to any town you've been to or waystone you've woken, and Homeward Feathers and Bridge of Light reach them too.
Some quests are favours now: carry something to someone in another land, and bring back what they send.
Elite quests ask more of you for bigger rewards, and every quest shows how hard it is, from Easy to Elite.

Every land builds its own homes now: adobe houses and tents in the desert, beach huts by the sea, snowy cabins and an igloo in the north, stilt huts in the swamps and crooked cottages where it's spooky.
Heroes hold their weapon upright at their side when they face you, and a whip's lash hangs down to their feet.

changelog.title: Hats of their own
notes: Every helmet, hood, coif and wizard's hat is a hat of its own now, worn in the Hat slot: one for each armour, in its colour, sold, dropped and given wherever the armour is.
An armour and its hat together are worth what the armour was, and the hats for the armour you already have are waiting in your bag.
A barber in every town gives you a new hairstyle and hair colour, for 1000 gold.
The world map shows who's where in the lands you've been to, and bats keep to their own lands.

changelog.title: Into the deep
notes: The Glimmerdeep goes two levels deeper, down ladders to its heart, where the Prism Drake sleeps, and Pip can draw you a map of every level. New monsters live down there and on Starfall Isle, and a few can mend themselves once a fight.
Every cave has a map of its own: tap the minimap to see what you've explored.
Quests are numbered and marked with a gold star, and the Quests page can search, sort and filter them.
Tidier Character and Companions screens, no more bulging foreheads seen from the side, bearded dwarves show their mouths, and recoloured monsters and characters take their new colour all over.
Robes, chain mail, capes, festive hats and masks are redrawn to fit every hero, weapons in hand look crisp, Christmas brings striped scarves, and What's new sums up each big update in a few lines.

changelog.title: Villages and gear you can see
notes: Every land has a village now, with 75 new quests from level 2 to 195, a treasure at the end of each village's story and dozens of villagers to meet.
Starfall Isle has a fairy village, Glimmerbough, and under it the Glimmerdeep, a cave of singing crystal. The Fallen Star and the Prism Drake are new bosses.
Level 200 is the top: Elder Oak's last quests earn the Goldleaf gear, and your name shines gold.
Gloves, boots and necklaces show on your hero, and armour comes in nine colour tiers from Copper to Topaz, a set for every guild.
Festive seasons: Halloween, Christmas, the New Year and Easter each bring treats and a hat for your new head slot.

changelog.title: Starfall Isle
notes: Sail from Sneezle Sands to Starfall Isle, a new island where a star fell long ago, once Captain Brine's ship is ready.
Quests can ask you to bring things: monsters drop them, chests hold them, and some you carve or piece together yourself.
Status capes: beat every monster in a land, or finish a whole collection, and Orla the Weaver makes you a cape to wear.
Adventurers travel in groups. They can turn down your invite, let you join their party, and move on after a while.
Caves open into rocky hills, music fades from land to land, and frost monsters live in the cold north.

changelog.title: One continent
notes: The lands are one world now: walk anywhere on the continent with no loading screen and no stop at a border, the ground, music, weather and monsters changing as you go.
Lands load in moments, and you can walk on into the next before it has finished.
Roads fade from one land's look into the next and are lined here and there with fences, walls, hedges or lanterns.
Treasure chests fill up again after a while, with gold and something new.
The coast slopes down into a sea that's paler in the shallows.

changelog.title: A world of shapes
notes: The lands lie side by side as one continent, each with a shape of its own: snow and ice in the north, deserts and beaches in the south.
Walk over a border anywhere. A fence, rocks or a city wall stands where a quest still keeps the way closed.
Tap the minimap for the world map: the whole continent as it really looks, to drag about and zoom.
Rivers run from their springs to the sea or into a lake, and the land slopes down to the shore.
Towns sit in countryside of their own, and Prismhaven and Ingothold are walled in stone.

changelog.title: Hills, mountains and rivers
notes: Every land has hills, and some have mountains: climb them anywhere, and look for the chests and bosses on the summits.
Lakes and rivers with bridges and jetties, and footpaths winding across the fields.
The sun crosses the sky, and shadows turn and stretch with the time of day.
People live out in the lands with stories of their own, and the minimap shows who's who.
Quests give treasures no monster drops, the Bag can be searched and sorted, and a gold arrow marks better gear.

changelog.title: Something every day
notes: A gift each day you play, three daily bounties, titles to earn and rewards as the Monster Book fills.
Every monster has a card: collect them for Tilly the Toymaker, and give toys to your companions.
Seal Stones work on any monster at any HP, in five kinds up to the rainbow Wishing Seal.
Gloves, boots and necklaces have slots of their own, round your hero on the Character screen.
A calmer battle screen, one kind of window everywhere, richer sound and a How to play that plays the game.

changelog.title: Welcome to Dorlune
notes: The towns, lands and people have new names.
The game speaks eleven languages, and the story at the start is told in animated pictures.
Day and night and changing weather, and your wounds stay with you between fights.
Every skill has a look of its own, new spells raise and lower stats, and friends think before they act.
Faster fights with 2× and Auto, gear dropped by monsters, Homeward Feathers and backups to Files.

changelog.title: Bosses with a story
notes: Bosses fight in waves, and tell a short story when you beat them.
Parties of five, companions that take orders, poison and curses, and dark caves lit only by your light.
Play several heroes, each with a save of their own.
Trade with adventurers, sell to shops, and keep a Monster Book of everything you meet.
A livelier world: candy Gumdrop Peaks, little animals and birds, and adventurers dressed for their level.

changelog.title: A bigger Dorlune
notes: The world grows to 30 maps, with a world atlas, winding roads, caves, snowfall, icy ponds and busier towns.
Every item and skill has its own art, magic weapons glow, and blacksmiths forge gear from monster materials.
A storybook soundtrack, new sound effects with volume settings, an intro for new heroes and a What's new list.

changelog.title: First steps into Dorlune
notes: 14 maps joined by winding roads: Meadowbrook, Prismhaven and Ingothold, plus wild zones from Sunny Meadow to Moonwhisper.
Random encounters and turn-based battles fought where you stand. Big spells splash onto nearby monsters.
81 monsters across seven elements, with rare colour variants and three bosses.
Capture with Seal Stones and keep up to 5 companions. Your first hatches from the starter egg.
Quests, shops, healers, checkpoints, an in-game calendar and a chiptune soundtrack.
